Based on the screenshot provided, here are the answers to your questions:

1.  **What page is shown?**
    This is the **"Kontak & Sekretariat"** (Contact & Secretariat) page, specifically the **FAQ** (Frequently Asked Questions) tab within an administrative portal for "LAPRA 08".

2.  **How many FAQ items are visible?**
    There is **1** FAQ item visible on the screen.

3.  **What is the count number shown next to the title?**
    The count number is **(1)**, which appears next to "FAQ - Pertanyaan yang Sering Diajukan".

4.  **List all FAQ questions visible**
    *   **Bagaimana cara mendaftar menjadi anggota LAPRA 08?** (How to register as a member of LAPRA 08?)

5.  **Is there an edit button visible for each FAQ?**
    **Yes**, there is a blue pencil icon (edit button) visible on the right side of the FAQ item. There is also a red trash can icon (delete button) next to it.
